note: Hourly pulse: numbers only, paper/research. Point metrics: holders = Solada count; holders_onchain = Koios stake-grouped holders ex pool/curve (Cardano) or pump.fun totalHolders (Solana; GeckoTerminal for CATE); holders_native = Solana-native (pump.fun total minus escrow/deployer/pool, rule n); mcap_ada = on-chain pool/curve mcap; ada_side = pool or curve ADA, or the quote side in ADA-equivalent for Solana names; volume = 24h volume in ADA(-equivalent). No owner wallet data.
sources: Blockfrost: Minswap V2 pool UTxOs, first ~13 asset txs per curve launch (early buyers, buy sizes)
GeckoTerminal cardano token pools + hourly OHLCV (BOLT, PAWS, CLOVE, SER)
